Hello Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0397901 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
YES

YES

YES

Performance monitoring by RC
Upon analyzing the logs and the behavior of the charger, we found that there is an issue with the contactor, where the feedback from the contactor DC_Contactor_DC1_QA21-22 is not correct. The error is as follows: “[OPL] DC_Contactor_DC1_QA21-22: 1st plausibility check, hardware-based coil stuck after early timeout, CMD: 0, FBK: 1.”
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
